objective: Implement PRD-defined input ingestion, attribution, normalization, redaction, persistence, and provenance capture.
implemented_behaviors: Generated experience IDs now include PR, commit, recorded time, outcome kind, terminal state, signature ID, extraction confidence, signature class, check name, signature key, message fingerprint when present, and sorted provenance URLs.
Same-PR, same-commit, same-outcome records with different check or signature keys no longer overwrite each other during .relia/experiences/YYYY-MM.jsonl upsert.
Explicit input experience_id values remain authoritative and unchanged.

review_repair.finding: Include signature fields in generated experience IDs
